nodes.monety.text.t: "Three groats aren't bread, but they'll buy some." The woman slips the coins into her bosom. "I'll remember you, sir. Go in health."

nodes.odmow.text.t: The woman nods, no offence taken. "Nobody has. Go in health." The child stares at you blankly.

nodes.prowiant.text.t: The woman tucks the rations into her apron. "May Mother keep you, sir." The child smiles for the first time in a long while.

nodes.rabuj.text.t: The woman doesn't fight back. In the bundle: a few groats, a pinch of salt and three onions. Well done. You've robbed a widow of three onions.

nodes.s.text.t: On a stump sits a woman with a child on her lap, staring at the ground. "I'm not asking for much, sir. Bread. Anything. The child hasn't eaten in three days."
